# acme/app

The storefront. Vehicle models and materials come from acme/assets.

prs.title: fix(configurator): lamp materials follow the lamps level
prs.body: Emissive materials with no lamp role now follow the lamps level, so the lamps off → on beat reads in showcase films. Side effect: the configurator shows lamps off by default, so their glow is dark.

prs.title: docs(decisions): decision 20, glow without a lamp role
prs.body: Option a: glow with no lamp role follows the lamps level too. Records the dark configurator as a known side effect.
